articles.title: Lucknow Ruckus: Woman Police Officer, Auto Driver Clash on Road Over Fare Dispute
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Lucknow – A controversial incident from Vibhutikhand area has triggered debate after a scuffle broke out between a woman police officer and an elderly auto driver over fare payment.

body.html:
Lucknow – A controversial incident from Vibhutikhand area has triggered debate after a scuffle broke out between a woman police officer and an elderly auto driver over fare payment.

According to locals, the woman officer often travels in autos but allegedly misbehaves with drivers when asked for fare. On Friday, when the elderly driver demanded payment, the dispute escalated into a scuffle before passersby intervened.

Auto drivers claimed this was not the first such case, alleging repeated quarrels with women police personnel over non-payment. The viral video of the clash at Polytechnic intersection shows a heated argument, drawing a crowd on the spot.

Police officials confirmed that an inquiry has been initiated and statements from both sides are being recorded. Authorities said action will be taken once the facts are clear.

articles.title: Hoshiarpur Tragedy: LPG Tanker Blast Kills 2, Injures 23; Shops & Homes Reduced to Ashes
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hoshiarpur (Punjab) – A devastating accident struck Mandiala Adda late Friday night when an LPG tanker collided with another vehicle and exploded, triggering a massive fire that engulfed around 15 shops and 4–5 houses nearby.

body.html:
Hoshiarpur (Punjab) – A devastating accident struck Mandiala Adda late Friday night when an LPG tanker collided with another vehicle and exploded, triggering a massive fire that engulfed around 15 shops and 4–5 houses nearby.

At least 2 people lost their lives, one identified as Balwant Rai, while the other remains unidentified. Hospital officials confirmed 23 people admitted with burn injuries, several in critical condition, with 5–8 referred to higher medical centres for advanced treatment.

The explosion was so powerful that it was heard several kilometres away, sparking panic as flames spread instantly due to the gas leak. Emergency teams rushed to the spot, and the fire has since been brought under control.

Residents staged protests, highlighting repeated warnings about the danger of gas tankers frequently passing and parking in the area. Officials have assured free treatment for all victims, while Punjab Minister Ravjot Singh promised full support and announced an inquiry, including a probe into the nearby Hindustan Petroleum LPG bottling plant.

The condition of several injured remains critical, and rescue and relief operations are ongoing.

articles.title: Hardoi Daylight Con: Fraudsters Trick Elderly Woman, Flee With Gold & Silver Jewellery Worth Lakhs
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hardoi – In a shocking case from Awas Vikas Colony under City Kotwali area, two conmen duped an elderly woman, Rajkumari Singh, of jewellery worth lakhs in broad daylight. The woman was returning from a temple when the youths approached her, offering to clean her jewellery.

body.html:
Hardoi – In a shocking case from Awas Vikas Colony under City Kotwali area, two conmen duped an elderly woman, Rajkumari Singh, of jewellery worth lakhs in broad daylight.

The woman was returning from a temple when the youths approached her, offering to clean her jewellery. To gain her trust, they first polished her silver anklet. Soon after, they escaped with nearly 7 tola gold ornaments and silver jewellery, including her bracelet and chain.

The entire escape was captured on CCTV, where the accused can be seen fleeing on a motorcycle while a local youth tried to chase them. The video is now viral on social media.

Police have registered a case on the victim’s complaint and launched an investigation. Locals, however, expressed anger at rising daylight crimes, alleging police failure in controlling such incidents.

In the first video, Naushad, brother of BSP leader Haji Arif, is seen hurling abusive language at PM Narendra Modi and CM Yogi Adityanath, triggering outrage on social media.

The second video shows Arif’s nephew Mushahid brutally assaulting a youth named Aamir for supporting BJP. The clip captures Mushahid mercilessly kicking, punching and slapping Aamir, while bystanders tried to intervene.

Police immediately swung into action after the videos went viral, arresting Naushad and Mushahid and sending them to jail. Officials stated clearly: “No one is above the law.”

Haji Arif has been in the political spotlight before, earlier securing a BSP ticket from Garhmukteshwar, though later cancelled. His wife currently holds a district panchayat seat. The fresh controversy involving his family has now shaken both the district and state politics.

articles.title: Agra Woman Threatens Suicide, Levels Allegations Against Police – Officials Call Claims False
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Agra: A serious dispute has emerged between a local woman and Trans Yamuna Police. The complainant, Sarju Yadav of Kalindi Vihar, alleged that police ignored a theft case at her house and behaved indecently with her.

body.html:
Agra: A serious dispute has emerged between a local woman and Trans Yamuna Police. The complainant, Sarju Yadav of Kalindi Vihar, alleged that police ignored a theft case at her house and behaved indecently with her. She claimed that if justice is not delivered, she may take her own life, holding the station staff and Inspector-in-Charge responsible. She also accused suspended inspector Rajkumar Goswami, earlier linked to her case, of misconduct.

Police, however, have given a different version. On 19 August 2025, when Sarju Yadav visited the station to inquire about her case (Crime No. 370/24), officials informed her that the matter had been closed in January. According to police, she then began videography inside the station, and when stopped, allegedly abused and misbehaved with the lady sub-inspector at the women’s help desk.

Officials said that despite repeated persuasion, she continued creating disturbance, attempted self-harm, and was challaned under Sections 126/135/170 BNS before being produced in court. Police termed her allegations “baseless and false.”
